# Placid

Placid is a creative automation toolkit that enables users to generate images, PDFs, and videos from custom templates via REST or URL APIs.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/placid/.

## Actions

- **Create Template**: Create a new placid template.
- **Delete Template**: Delete a specific template identified by uuid.
- **Get Collections** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all template collections.
